Specification of Communication Management
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
[SWS_CM_00823] Default value of Minimum Send Interval and disabling Mini-
mum Send Interval monitoring for Methods
⌈
If the configured Minimum Send Inter-
val (
ServiceInterfaceDeploymentElement
.
minimumSendInterval
) of a Re-
quest&Response or Fire&Forget method has the value 0, the Minimum Send Inter-
val monitoring shall not be active for the method and its corresponding
operator
()
, i.e.,
ara::com
will not limit the Tx frequency by dropping method calls by the
client. For each Field of a
ServiceInterfaceDeployment
, 0 shall be the de-
fault value for the corresponding
ServiceInterfaceDeploymentElement
.
mini-
mumSendInterval
. This means that unless
ServiceInterfaceDeploymentEle-
ment
.
minimumSendInterval
for a given method is explicitly configured to be > 0,
the Tx rate is not limited by
ara::com
.
⌋
7.5.20 Update notification events for fields
[SWS_CM_00120] Provision of an update notification event for a Field
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00218
⌈
If
hasNotifier
is true, update notification events for the
Field
shall be provided as
of the following requirements:
• [SWS_CM_00141] Method to subscribe to a service event. This subscribe leads
immediately to a service event that contains the initial field value send from
provider side to the consumer.
• [SWS_CM_00151] Method to unsubscribe from a service event.
• [SWS_CM_00316] Method to query the subscription state.
• [SWS_CM_00701] Method to receive a service event using polling.
• [SWS_CM_00181] Method to enable service event trigger.
• [SWS_CM_00182] Event Receive Handler call serialization.
• [SWS_CM_00183] Method to disable service event trigger.
• [SWS_CM_00333] Method to set a subscription state change handler.
• [SWS_CM_00334] Method to unset a subscription state change handler.
Except that the corresponding methods reside in the
Field
class instead of the
Event
class.
